callPolicy.targetExecution: Low=one complete selected Post with zero Local/Dynamic calls; Local=one core Post plus zero-or-one serial shared Dynamic 4B call; selected Post starts independently from VCON-016 current-turn translation

currentDebt: Local core and Low complete-Post transport schemas remain separately provider-aware; server settlement is the shape authority.

Selected provider is exclusive: Low uses the Low Connection Profile and directly carries bounded Item/direct-injury candidates; Local uses Ollama core and may route one shared 4B call. There is no cross-provider fallback, repair, semantic Regex fallback, synthetic perception fallback, or Low-to-Dynamic substitute after selected-provider failure.

Selected Post capacity is measured over System, User, transport Schema and output reserve. Low uses its selected role capacity; Local uses its independent fixed context. Permitted compaction is atomic and diagnostic; protected sections are never cut.

Current-turn scheduling submits the selected post independently from VCON-016 current-message translation after paid English is saved and visible. When both tasks are local, the existing one-resident FIFO may serialize execution without changing eligibility.
Any selected Post no-fit/provider/schema/guard failure preserves paid narration as post_unsettled, blocks the next action, and allows only explicit Post-only retry or discard.
Temporal claims are transient guard inputs and never write clock or Calendar State.
Low Item/Identity candidates reuse VCON-014/VCON-020 guards and reducers; the Low result never writes State directly.
Revision 16 removes eventBoundary from this immediate contract and adds explicit Actor locationKnown settlement.
